payloads: Opaque parameterized context, statistics and noise vectors; default widths 1024,512,256 are transport capacities, not final calibration-table ABI
admission: One in-flight context. Results require context admitted on an earlier edge. No same-edge retire/new-context bypass
result_inputs: Ready whenever not reset/cancel; stale, duplicate or unowned result handshakes are consumed and explicitly rejected; only first matching result retained
context_rejected: Pulse for attempted context_valid while not ready and not cancel/reset; caller must obey context_ready for actual admission
publication: result_valid only after both matching inputs accepted; key and three payloads immutable until consumer handshake, cancel or reset
cancel: Gates ready/valid and discards local partial/completed context; aborted pulse iff context was owned; no external producer cancellation or RAM reference release implied
reset: Clears local ownership; caller must change epoch or otherwise guarantee no key reuse with in-flight old producers
caller_obligations: unique complete key for each transaction
validate payload semantics and field layout
bind all referenced calibration/settings to config_version
coordinate cancellation with producer queues and bank owner
manage backpressure or explicit trigger rejection
do not use a single bank_generation for unequal per-group generations; instantiate per bank or use a validated transaction identity
